name: checkInvocationExpressionDefaultValueBindingConnector
prose: An InvocationExpression must own a BindingConnector between the featureWithValue and value Expression of any FeatureValue that is the effective default value for a feature of the instantiatedType of the InvocationExpression.

name: checkFlowSpecialization
prose: A Flow must directly or indirectly specialize the Step Transfers::transfers from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: checkPayloadFeatureRedefinition
prose: A PayloadFeature must redefine the Feature Transfers::Transfer::payload from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: checkLiteralRationalSpecialization
prose: A LiteralRational must directly or indirectly specialize Performances::literalRationalEvaluations from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: checkConnectorTypeFeaturing
prose: Each relatedFeature of a Connector must have each featuringType of the Connector as a direct or indirect featuringType (where a Feature with no featuringType is treated as if the Classifier Base::Anything was its featuringType).
ocl_body: relatedFeature->forAll(f |      if featuringType->isEmpty() then f.isFeaturedWithin(null)     else featuringType->forAll(t | f.isFeaturedWithin(t))     endif)

name: checkFeaturePortionSpecialization
prose: If a Feature has isPortion = true, an ownedTyping relationship to a Class, and an owningType that is a Class or another Feature typed by a Class, then it must directly or indirectly specialize Occurrences::Occurrence::portions from the Kernel Semantic Library.
ocl_body: isPortion and ownedTyping.type->includes(oclIsKindOf(Class)) and owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Class) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Feature) and     owningType.oclAsType(Feature).type->         exists(oclIsKindOf(Class))) implies     specializesFromLibrary('Occurrence::Occurrence::portions')

name: checkFeatureParameterRedefinition
prose: If a Feature is a parameter of an owningType that is a Behavior or Step, but not A result parameter A parameter of an InvocationExpression, with at least one non-implied ownedRedefinition then, for each direct supertype of its owningType that is also a Behavior or Step, it must redefine the parameter at the same position, if any.
ocl_body: owningType <> null and not owningFeatureMembership.     oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership) and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step) and     (owningType.oclIsKindOf(InvocationExpression) implies       not ownedRedefinition->exists(not isImplied))  implies     let i : Integer =         owningType.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->             reject(owningFeatureMembership.                 oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership))->             indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |             let ownedParameters : Sequence(Feature) =                 supertype.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->                      reject(owningFeatureMembership.                          oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership)) in             ownedParameters->size() >= i implies                 redefines(ownedParameters->at(i))

name: checkAssociationStructureSpecialization
prose: An AssociationStructure must directly or indirectly specialize the base AssociationStructure Objects::LinkObject from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: checkAssociationBinarySpecialization
prose: A binary Association must directly or indirectly specialize the base Association Links::binaryLink from the Kernel Semantic Library.

name: checkExpressionTypeFeaturing
prose: If this Expression is owned by a FeatureValue, then it must have the same featuringTypes as the featureWithValue of the FeatureValue.
ocl_body: owningMembership <> null and  owningMembership.oclIsKindOf(FeatureValue) implies     let featureWithValue : Feature =          owningMembership.oclAsType(FeatureValue).featureWithValue in     featuringType = featureWithValue.featuringType

name: deriveFlowTargetInputFeature
prose: The targetInputFeature of a Flow is the first ownedFeature of the second connectorEnd of the Flow.
ocl_body: targetInputFeature =     if connectorEnd->size() < 2 or          connectorEnd->at(2).ownedFeature->isEmpty()     then null     else connectorEnd->at(2).ownedFeature->first()     endif

name: deriveNamespaceOwnedMember
prose: The ownedMembers of a Namespace are the ownedMemberElements of all its ownedMemberships that are OwningMemberships.

name: deriveMembershipImportImportedElement
prose: The importedElement of a MembershipImport is the memberElement of its importedMembership.

name: deriveFeatureOwnedRedefinition
prose: The ownedRedefinitions of a Feature are its ownedSubsettings that are Redefinitions.

name: deriveFeatureType
prose: The types of a Feature are the union of the types of its typings and the types of the Features it subsets, with all redundant supertypes removed. If the Feature has chainingFeatures, then the union also includes the types of the last chainingFeature.
ocl_body: type =      let types : OrderedSet(Types) = OrderedSet{self}->         -- Note: The closure operation automatically handles circular relationships.         closure(typingFeatures()).typing.type->asOrderedSet() in     types->reject(t1 | types->exist(t2 | t2 <> t1 and t2.specializes(t1)))

name: deriveRelationshipRelatedElement
prose: The relatedElements of a Relationship consist of all of its source Elements followed by all of its target Elements.

name: deriveAssociationSourceType
prose: The sourceType of an Association is its first relatedType (if any).
ocl_body: sourceType = if relatedType->isEmpty() then null else relatedType->first() endif

name: derivePackageFilterCondition
prose: The filterConditions of a Package are the conditions of its owned ElementFilterMemberships.

name: deriveMultiplicityRangeUpperBound
prose: If a MultiplicityRange has one ownedMember that is an Expression, then this is the upperBound. If it has more than one ownedMember that is an Expression, then the upperBound is the second of those. Otherwise, it is null.
ocl_body: upperBound =     let ownedExpressions : Sequence(Expression) =         ownedMember->selectByKind(Expression) in     if ownedExpressions->isEmpty() then null     else if ownedExpressions->size() = 1 then ownedExpressions->at(1)     else ownedExpressions->at(2)     endif endif

name: deriveTypeOwnedFeature
prose: The ownedFeatures of a Type are the ownedMemberFeatures of its ownedFeatureMemberships.

name: validateElementIsImpliedIncluded
prose: If an Element has any ownedRelationships for which isImplied = true, then the Element must also have isImpliedIncluded = true. (Note that an Element can have isImplied = true even if no ownedRelationships have isImplied = true, indicating the Element simply has no implied Relationships.

name: validateTypeOwnedUnioningNotOne
prose: A Type must not have exactly one ownedUnioning.

name: validateCrossSubsettingCrossingFeature
prose: The crossingFeature of a CrossSubsetting must be an end Feature that is owned by a Type with at least two end Features.

name: validateClassifierMultiplicityDomain
prose: If a Classifier has a multiplicity, then the multiplicity must have no featuringTypes (meaning that its domain is implicitly Base::Anything).

name: validateMetadataFeatureAnnotatedElement
prose: The annotatedElements of a MetadataFeature must have an abstract syntax metaclass consistent with the annotatedElement declarations for the MetadataFeature.
ocl_body: let baseAnnotatedElementFeature : Feature =     resolveGlobal('Metaobjects::Metaobject::annotatedElement').memberElement.     oclAsType(Feature) in let annotatedElementFeatures : OrderedSet(Feature) = feature->     select(specializes(baseAnnotatedElementFeature))->     excluding(baseAnnotatedElementFeature) in annotatedElementFeatures->notEmpty() implies     let annotatedElementTypes : Set(Feature) =         annotatedElementFeatures.typing.type->asSet() in     let metaclasses : Set(Metaclass) =         annotatedElement.oclType().qualifiedName->collect(qn |              resolveGlobal(qn).memberElement.oclAsType(Metaclass)) in    metaclasses->forAll(m | annotatedElementTypes->exists(t | m.specializes(t)))

name: validateFlowEndOwningType
prose: The owningType of a FlowEnd must be a Flow.

name: validateElementFilterMembershipConditionIsBoolean
prose: The result parameter of the condition Expression must directly or indirectly specialize ScalarValues::Boolean.

name: validateMultiplicityRangeBounds
prose: The lowerBound (if any) and upperBound Expressions must be the first ownedMembers of a MultiplicityRange.
ocl_body: if lowerBound = null then     ownedMember->notEmpty() and     ownedMember->at(1) = upperBound else     ownedMember->size() > 1 and     ownedMember->at(1) = lowerBound and     ownedMember->at(2) = upperBound endif

name: validateFeatureChainingFeatureNotOne
prose: A Feature must have either no chainingFeatures or more than one.

name: validateFunctionResultExpressionMembership
prose: A Function must have at most one ResultExpressionMembership.

name: checkSuccessionFlowUsageSpecialization
prose: A SuccessionFlowUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the base FlowUsage Flows::successionFlows from the Systems Library model.

name: checkAnalysisCaseUsageSubAnalysisCaseSpecialization
prose: A composite AnalysisCaseUsage whose owningType is an AnalysisCaseDefinition or AnalysisCaseUsage must specialize the AnalysisCaseUsage AnalysisCases::AnalysisCase::subAnalysisCases from the Systems Model Library.
ocl_body: isComposite and owningType <> null and     (owningType.oclIsKindOf(AnalysisCaseDefinition) or      owningType.oclIsKindOf(AnalysisCaseUsage)) implies     specializesFromLibrary('AnalysisCases::AnalysisCase::subAnalysisCases')

name: checkConcernUsageFramedConcernSpecialization
prose: If a ConcernUsage is owned via a FramedConcernMembership, then it must directly or indirectly specialize the ConcernUsage Requirements::RequirementCheck::concerns from the Systems Model Library.

name: checkPortDefinitionSpecialization
prose: A PortDefinition must directly or indirectly specialize the PortDefinition Ports::Port from the Systems Model Library.

name: checkActionUsageStateActionRedefinition
prose: An ActionUsage that is the entry, do, or exit Action of a StateDefinition or StateUsage must redefine the entryAction, doAction, or exitAction feature, respectively, of the StateDefinition States::StateAction from the Systems Model Library.
ocl_body: owningFeatureMembership <> null and owningFeatureMembership.oclIsKindOf(StateSubactionMembership) implies     let kind : StateSubactionKind =          owningFeatureMembership.oclAsType(StateSubactionMembership).kind in     if kind = StateSubactionKind::entry then         redefinesFromLibrary('States::StateAction::entryAction')     else if kind = StateSubactionKind::do then         redefinesFromLibrary('States::StateAction::doAction')     else         redefinesFromLibrary('States::StateAction::exitAction')     endif endif

name: checkPartUsageSubpartSpecialization
prose: A composite PartUsage whose owningType is a ItemDefinition or ItemUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the PartUsage Items::Item::subparts from the Systems Model Library.
ocl_body: isComposite and owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(ItemDefinition) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(ItemUsage)) implies     specializesFromLibrary('Items::Item::subparts')

name: checkWhileLoopActionUsageSubactionSpecialization
prose: A composite WhileLoopActionUsage that is a subaction usage must directly or indirectly specialize the ActionUsage Actions::Action::whileLoops from the Systems Model Library.

name: checkAcceptActionUsageTriggerActionSpecialization
prose: An AcceptActionUsage that is the triggerAction of TransitionUsage must directly or indirectly specialize the ActionUsage Actions::TransitionAction::accepter from the Systems Model Library.

name: checkPerformActionUsageSpecialization
prose: If a PerformActionUsage has an owningType that is a PartDefinition or PartUsage, then it must directly or indirectly specialize the ActionUsage Parts::Part::performedActions.
ocl_body: owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(PartDefinition) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(PartUsage)) implies     specializesFromLibrary('Parts::Part::performedActions')

name: checkUsageVariationDefinitionSpecialization
prose: If a Usage has an owningVariationDefinition, then it must directly or indirectly specialize that Definition.

name: deriveDefinitionOwnedView
prose: The ownedViews of a Definition are all its ownedUsages that are ViewUsages.

name: deriveAllocationDefinitionAllocation
prose: The allocations of an AllocationDefinition are all its usages that are AllocationUsages.

name: deriveDefinitionOwnedMetadata
prose: The ownedMetadata of a Definition are all its ownedUsages that are MetadataUsages.

name: deriveTransitionUsageTarget
prose: The target of a TransitionUsage is given by the featureTarget of the targetFeature of its succession, which must be an ActionUsage.
ocl_body: target =     if succession.targetFeature->isEmpty() then null     else         let targetFeature : Feature =             succession.targetFeature->first().featureTarget in         if not targetFeature.oclIsKindOf(ActionUsage) then null         else targetFeature.oclAsType(ActionUsage)         endif     endif

name: deriveAcceptActionUsageReceiverArgument
prose: The receiverArgument of an AcceptUsageAction is its second argument Expression.

name: deriveUsageNestedRequirement
prose: The ownedRequirements of a Usage are all its ownedUsages that are RequirementUsages.

name: deriveCaseUsageObjectiveRequirement
prose: The objectiveRequirement of a CaseUsage is the RequirementUsage it owns via an ObjectiveMembership, if any.
ocl_body: objectiveRequirement =      let objectives: OrderedSet(RequirementUsage) =          featureMembership->             selectByKind(ObjectiveMembership).             ownedRequirement in     if objectives->isEmpty() then null     else objectives->first().ownedObjectiveRequirement     endif

name: deriveVerificationCaseUsageVerifiedRequirement
prose: The verifiedRequirements of a VerificationCaseUsage are the verifiedRequirements of its RequirementVerificationMemberships.
ocl_body: verifiedRequirement =     if objectiveRequirement = null then OrderedSet{}     else          objectiveRequirement.featureMembership->             selectByKind(RequirementVerificationMembership).             verifiedRequirement->asOrderedSet()     endif

name: deriveDefinitionOwnedCalculation
prose: The ownedCalculations of a Definition are all its ownedUsages that are CalculationUsages.

name: deriveCaseDefinitionActorParameter
prose: The actorParameters of a CaseDefinition are the ownedActorParameters of the ActorMemberships of the CaseDefinition.

name: validateFlowDefinitionFlowEnds
prose: A FlowDefinition may not have more than two flowEnds.

name: validateAttributeUsageFeatures
prose: All features of an AttributeUsage must be non-composite.

name: validateRequirementVerificationMembershipKind
prose: A RequirementVerificationMembership must have kind = requirement.

name: validatePerformActionUsageReference
prose: If a PerformActionUsage has an ownedReferenceSubsetting, then the featureTarget of the referencedFeature must be an ActionUsage.

name: validateMergeNodeOutgoingSuccessions
prose: A MergeNode may have at most one outgoing Succession.

name: validateVariantMembershipOwningNamespace
prose: The membershipOwningNamespace of a VariantMembership must be a variation-point Definition or Usage.

name: validateForkNodeIncomingSuccessions
prose: A ForkNode may have at most one incoming Succession.

name: validateControlNodeIncomingSuccessions
prose: All incoming Successions to a ControlNode must have a target multiplicity of 1..1.

name: validateDecisionNodeIncomingSuccessions
prose: A DecisionNode may have at most one incoming Succession.

name: validateCaseDefinitionOnlyOneSubject
prose: A CaseDefinition must have at most one featureMembership that is a SubjectMembership.
